page: Microsoft Azure E8-4ads_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine running on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. Powered by an x86_64 AMD processor, this configuration features 4 dedicated vCPUs deployed on an 8-vCPU chassis alongside 64.0 GB of system memory. This architecture delivers an elevated allocation of 16.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance does not include graphical processing units (0 GPUs) and does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Storage capability includes 472 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD capacity, and the instance is compatible with Azure Premium Storage. The constrained core design paired with high memory density provides cost efficiency for environments subject to per-core software licensing fees, allowing memory-heavy operations without paying for unused compute capacity. A notable tradeoff is the bounded multi-core compute throughput of 4 threads and the ephemeral nature of direct-attached NVMe storage.

Given the high memory ratio and rapid local NVMe storage, the Microsoft Azure E8-4ads_v7 is structured for memory-intensive workloads that require moderate CPU concurrency. Common deployments include relational database management systems, in-memory key-value stores, distributed caches, and analytical processing engines.
